message.content:
I’m really sorry you’re having trouble fitting your new pair! 👟✨

### Why the Size Difference Happens  
1. **Brand‑specific sizing** – Even though both items say “UK 34,” each manufacturer uses its own conversion table. One company’s UK 34 may actually run closer to a US 32/33, while another runs slightly larger.  
2. **Measurement method** – Some labels measure waist circumference at the natural waistline, others at the hips or mid‑rise. That can add up to several centimeters.  
3. **Fabric stretch & cut** – Stretchy fabrics shrink after washing, whereas rigid materials stay true to their original dimensions.

Because of those variables, two identical numbers don’t always mean the same physical length.

---

#### What You Can Do Right Now  

| Option | How It Helps |
|--------|--------------|
| **Return / Exchange** | Most stores allow returns within 30 days. If you still want this style, send it back and pick a different size or brand. |
| **Check the Brand’s Size Chart** | Look online for the exact measurements listed for UK 34. Compare them to what you measured previously. |
| **Try On Another Pair First** | If you’re buying again, consider trying on a sample or using a virtual try‑on feature (if available) to see how the fit looks. |

If you’d like, share the *exact* product ID or SKU (the number usually found on the tag), and I can pull up the official size chart from our database right now—just let me know!

Otherwise, feel free to reach out to the retailer’s customer support team—they’ll guide you through the return/exchange steps quickly. Let me know if there’s anything else I can do to help!
